entities.name: Thomas von Westen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas von Westen was a Norwegian Lutheran priest and missionary. He was a driving force in the Sami mission, and founded the education institution Seminarium Scholasticum, the later Seminarium Lapponicum, in Trondheim.
